statement: The function returns a result r, and r = true if and only if there exists a set S of indices such that S is a subset of {0, 1, ..., len(nums)-1}, |S| >= 2, and the bitwise OR of nums[k] over all k in S is even (equivalently, has at least one trailing zero in binary).
preconditions: nums is a slice of 64-bit signed integers with 2 <= len(nums) <= 100, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100.
